description: This file defines API routes for managing calendar events, including create, retrieve, update, delete, and list operations. It leverages FastAPI and depends on other components such as schemas, models, repositories, and clients for weather and notifications. The routes handle event recurrence expansion, optional weather data inclusion, and pagination.

methods.name: create_event( event: EventCreate, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repository), notification_client: NotificationClient = Depends(get_notification_client), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new calendar event and schedule reminders.

methods.name: get_event( event_id: str, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repository), include_weather: bool = Query(False, description="If true, include weather context"), weather_client: WeatherClient = Depends(get_weather_client) )
methods.description: Retrieve an event by ID, optionally including weather forecast.

methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of events, with optional filters and weather data.
